changelog: FIX: Vales duplicados — _flattenValesFromSB ahora deduplica por vale ID (seenIds Set).
FIX: _doRestPoll merge deduplica vales por ID antes de guardar en localStorage.
FIX: listenToMyVales merge también deduplica por ID.
FIX: Admin init ya no escribe vales en formato anidado viejo — usa formato flat (una fila por vale).
FIX: Supabase limpiado — filas viejas con formato anidado eliminadas.
FIX: _productosMap invalidated after saveProductos — productoOf() returns fresh data.
FIX: Product objects no longer mutated in-place — shallow clone in render functions.
FIX: PDF print dialog no longer fires twice — added 'printed' flag guard.
FIX: Estafa modal close uses this.closest() instead of broad selector.
FIX: Initials generation handles double/trailing spaces.
FIX: Rank notification array index clamped with Math.max(0, ...).
FIX: callback == null for restored queue items.
FIX: parseFloat commission — $0 no longer cleared.
FIX: Phone normalization regex — only [57] prefix (Cuban mobile/landline).
